[[File:Rhombicosahedron.stl|thumb|3D model of a rhombicosahedron]]
In [[geometry]], the '''rhombicosahedron''' is a [[nonconvex uniform polyhedron]], indexed as U<sub>56</sub>. It has 50 faces (30 [[Square|squares]] and 20 [[Hexagon|hexagons]]), 120 edges and 60 vertices.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mathconsult.ch/static/unipoly/56.html|title=56: rhombicosahedron|last=Maeder|first=Roman|date=|website=MathConsult|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref> Its [[vertex figure]] is an [[antiparallelogram]].

== Related polyhedra ==

A '''rhombicosahedron''' shares its [[vertex arrangement]] with the [[Polyhedron compound#Uniform compounds|uniform compounds]] of [[compound of ten triangular prisms|10]] or [[compound of twenty triangular prisms|20 triangular prisms]]. It additionally shares its edges with the [[rhombidodecadodecahedron]] (having the square faces in common) and the [[icosidodecadodecahedron]] (having the hexagonal faces in common).

==Rhombicosacron==
{{Uniform polyhedra db|Uniform dual polyhedron stat table|rI}}
[[File:Rhombicosacron.stl|thumb|3D model of a rhombicosacron]]
The [[rhombicosacron]] is a nonconvex [[Isohedral figure|isohedral]] [[polyhedron]]. It is the [[Dual polyhedron|dual]] of the [[nonconvex uniform polyhedron|uniform]] rhombicosahedron, U<sub>56</sub>. It has 50 [[Vertex (geometry)|vertices]], 120 [[Edge (geometry)|edges]], and 60 [[crossed-quadrilateral]] faces.
